stories.headline: Claude Discovers a Novel CRISPR-Like Enzyme System
stories.blurb: Anthropic's Claude model has successfully discovered a completely novel biological enzyme system containing CRISPR-like repeats, demonstrating the growing capability of AI in genuine scientific exploration.

stories.headline: Claude Solves Massive Math Challenge with Super Yang-Mills Proof
stories.blurb: In a major theoretical physics milestone, Anthropic researchers used Claude to calculate the N=4 super Yang-Mills theory out to nine loops, showcasing its extreme reasoning capacity for complex mathematics.

stories.headline: Claude Opus 5.5 Optimizes for Long Coding Sessions
stories.blurb: Anthropic announced Claude Opus 5.5, engineered specifically to handle long-running, context-heavy software engineering tasks and coding workflows more effectively.

stories.headline: Google's Gemini 4 Enters Post-Training Phase
stories.blurb: Google has moved Gemini 4 into post-training, signaling that the three-way frontier AI race between Google, OpenAI, and Anthropic is tighter than ever.

stories.headline: How 17 Trillion Microsoft Records Were Exposed
stories.blurb: A security researcher detailed a critical cloud misconfiguration that could have allowed unauthorized access to over 17 trillion internal Microsoft records.

stories.headline: Salesforce Agentforce Vulns Allow Zero-Click CRM Theft
stories.blurb: Serious vulnerabilities discovered in Salesforce's Agentforce platform could allow attackers to steal CRM data and orchestrate phishing campaigns with zero-click exploits.

stories.headline: Supabase Customers Unwittingly Exposing Huge Swaths of Data
stories.blurb: A widespread configuration oversight has left several Supabase customers unintentionally exposing massive amounts of sensitive user data directly to the public web.

stories.headline: Docker Launches Secure Sandboxes to Contain AI Agents
stories.blurb: Docker launched secure sandboxes designed specifically to isolate autonomous AI agents, preventing untrusted code from wreaking havoc on local or production systems.

stories.headline: Ubuntu Forces Weekly Kernel Cycle to Combat CVE Flood
stories.blurb: To keep up with a relentless deluge of security vulnerabilities, Ubuntu is transitioning to a rapid weekly kernel release schedule to deliver patches faster.

stories.headline: How Engineers Made Claude.ai 3x Faster in Two Weeks
stories.blurb: Anthropic shared the engineering techniques, optimizations, and database architectural shifts they leveraged to triple the speed of the Claude.ai interface.

stories.headline: Meta Connect Unveils ‘Muse’ AR Smartglasses
stories.blurb: Meta showcased its new 'Muse' smartglasses, signaling a major hardware shift away from virtual worlds toward sleek, AI-integrated everyday wearables.

stories.headline: Meta Details Private Processing Architecture for AI Glasses
stories.blurb: Meta shared the details of its secure hardware design for smartglasses, combining on-device encryption and server-side isolation to protect user camera and voice data.

stories.headline: Unsecured OpenAI Agents Accidentally Leaked User Images
stories.blurb: Experimental OpenAI agents posted 53 user-uploaded images to the open internet, highlighting the data privacy and security challenges of autonomous agents.
